<infobox theme="Comic">
	<image source="image"></image>
	<title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="writer"><label>Writer(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="penciller"><label>Penciller(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="inker"><label>Inker(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="letterer"><label>Letterer(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="colorist"><label>Colorist(s)</label></data>
        <data source="cover artist"><label>Cover artist(s)</label></data>
        <data source="editor"><label>Editor(s)</label></data>			
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>	
        <data source="release date"><label>Publication date</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{release date|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{release date|}}}}}|future||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{release date|}}}}}|canceled||{{{release date}}}}}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>	
        <data source="other date"><label>Alternate release</label></data>	
        <data source="media type"><label>Media type</label></data>	
        <data source="pages"><label>Pages</label></data>
        <data source="isbn"><label>[[Wikipedia:International Standard Book Number|ISBN]]</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{{isbn}}}|none||[[Special:Booksources/{{{isbn}}}|{{{isbn}}}]]}}</format></data>
        <data source="isbn2"><label>ISBN2</label><format>{{#if:{{{isbn2|}}}|[[Special:Booksources/{{{isbn2}}}|{{{isbn2}}}]]}}</format></data>
    </group>
        <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="timeline"><label>Timeline</label></data>	
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>	
        <data source="issues"><label>Collected issues</label></data>
        <data source="preceded by"><label>Preceded by</label></data>
        <data source="followed by"><label>Followed by</label></data>			
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:ComicCollection|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|title|writer|penciller|inker|letterer|colorist|cover artist|editor|publisher|release date|other date|media type|pages|isbn|series|issues|preceded by|followed by|optional=no_year_check,isbn2,is_appearance,timeline}}<!--
-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|isbn|isbn2|no_timeline=1|no_year_check={{{no_year_check|}}}|template_name=ComicCollection|sort_key=8}}<!--
-->{{#if:{{{is_appearance|}}}|{{AppMediaCat}}|}}<noinclude>
==Usage==
Copy and paste the following code to use this template:

<pre>{{Top|real}}
{{ComicCollection
|image=
|title=
|writer=
|penciller=
|inker=
|letterer=
|colorist=
|cover artist=
|editor=
|publisher=
|release date=
|other date=
|media type=
|pages=
|isbn=
|isbn2=
|timeline=
|series=
|issues=
|preceded by=
|followed by=
}}</pre>
[[Category:Comic infoboxes]]</noinclude>
